p1.titolo: Do you know where your money goes?
p1.testo: TrackIt tells you. No spreadsheets, no hassle.

p2.titolo: Type expenses the way you'd say them
p2.testo: TrackIt does the rest: amount, date and category. You check and confirm.

p3.testo: Every expense updates your monthly budget in real time.

p4.testo: We remind you the day before. Cancel what you no longer use in time.
p4.testoWeb: See when each subscription is due, and automatic ones are logged on their own. Cancel what you no longer use in time.

p5.testo: Free account. All you need is an email and a password, or your Google account.

statistiche.testo: Your monthly spending split by category. Go back to past months to compare.

assistente.sottotitolo: Log expenses and ask questions in your own words
assistente.benvenuto: Hi! I'm the TrackIt assistant. Tell me what you bought, how much you spent and, if you like, when. If it's a recurring expense, I'll save it as a subscription. You can also ask me about your spending.
assistente.esempio5: How much did I spend on restaurants in September?
assistente.nonCapito: I couldn't understand that. Try telling me what you bought and how much you spent, for example "Pizza 15". If it's a question, add a question mark.
assistente.nonSalvato: I couldn't save it, please try again.
assistente.confermaPrima: Confirm or cancel the expense above

budgetNuovo.sottotitolo: Set how much you want to spend each month and the day your cycle starts
budgetNuovo.spiegazione: Your budget cycle restarts every month on this day (e.g. set 27 if you get paid on the 27th). If you leave 1, the budget follows the calendar month.
